# Bizooma

> AI-powered marketing and development solutions for law firms, nonprofits, and startups in Jacksonville, FL.

Bizooma builds SEO/AEO/Voice SEO programs, AI chatbots, custom websites, mobile apps, and lead-generation systems. We also build and publish our own products and tools.

## Frameworks
- [Order of Operations](https://bizooma.com/order-of-operations): The six-pillar framework for law firms — what to build to survive AI, and in what order.
- [Order of Operations for Nonprofits](https://bizooma.com/order-of-operations/nonprofits): The same six-pillar framework for nonprofits, with pillar one reframed around where freed hours go.

## Publishing
- [Route to Results](https://bizooma.com/route-to-results-newsletter): Weekly brief for law firms and nonprofits, working through the Order of Operations framework one pillar at a time.
- [Moving Jacksonville Forward](https://movingjaxforward.com): Weekly brief on what is being built in Jacksonville and what it means for the people there.

## Services

- [Services](/services): Overview of Bizooma services for law firms and nonprofits.
- [AI Marketing & Automation](/services/ai-marketing): Automating repeated work around intake, follow-up and content, with governance.
- [SEO & AEO](/services/seo-aeo): Findable in search and citable by AI assistants.
- [Websites & Apps](/services/websites-and-apps): Sites built around what a visitor came to do; apps where warranted.
- [Lead Generation & Intake](/services/lead-generation): Closing the gap between enquiry and conversation.
- [Apple Maps Marketing](/apple-maps-marketing): Visibility in Apple Maps and Siri results.
- [Accessibility Layer](/accessibility-layer): WCAG-compliant accessibility widget for any site.

## Products

- [Bizooma Labs](/labs): Everything Bizooma has built — live, in development, and retired.
- [Claude Cowork](/claude-cowork): Claude skills and tutorials for law firms and nonprofits.
- [WordPress Plugins](/wordpress-plugins): Custom WordPress plugins.
